chunks: We have indeed given you the seven oft-repeated (examples), and the majestic Qur'an.

key_terms.الْمَثَانِي: The seven oft-repeated verses, commonly identified as Surah Al-Fatiha

ai.seo_question: What are the seven oft-repeated verses (Al-Mathani) in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is central to the debate between the 'seven oft-repeated verses' (Al-Mathani) referring specifically to Surah Al-Fatiha or the entire Qur'an, with many scholars emphasizing Al-Fatiha as the essence of the Book. The term 'Al-Mathani' (the oft-repeated) highlights the Qur'an's structural repetition and its role as a healing and mercy for believers, reinforcing its status as the ultimate divine gift to Prophet Muhammad.
